hero.title: Grace Lutheran Church - Tulsa
hero.headline: Ancient faith | for today's Tulsa
hero.subtext: A warm, welcoming Lutheran congregation rooted in nearly 2,000 years of historic Christian tradition, gathered around Word and Sacrament since 1922.

items.label: Grow
items.description: In faith through Bible study and discipleship

items.label: Go
items.description: Into Tulsa proclaiming the Gospel in word and deed

whoWeAre.heading: Evangelical, catholic, biblical, and incarnational
whoWeAre.imageAlt: The altar dressed for Easter, lined with candles and lilies

marks.label: Evangelical
marks.text: The Gospel of Jesus Christ is central: forgiveness, life, and salvation through His death and resurrection.

marks.label: Catholic
marks.text: Members of the universal church, faithful heirs of nearly 2,000 years of Christian tradition and liturgy.

marks.label: Biblical
marks.text: The Holy Scriptures are the Word of God, sufficient for all faith and practice. Our liturgy and preaching are biblical.

marks.label: Incarnational
marks.text: God reveals Himself through Word and Sacrament: water, bread, wine, and the preaching of the Holy Gospel.
